setup: Manager/operator LLM agents issue module function calls from twin events; offline 100-case test
C1_note: LLM vs LLM only (7 models, pre-trained vs SFT); no PLC/rule baseline (p.6)
C2_note: Only command-match correctness and 1-5 reason plausibility; no control/production metrics (p.6)
C3_note: 32% of cases are unexpected events/abnormalities not covered by SOP (p.6)
C4_note: Single evaluation, no variance; models named, prompt structure in Table I, details on GitHub (pp.4,6)
C5_note: Command correctness rate over 100 test points per model and condition (Table II, p.6)
C6_note: No gate or validator; commands executed directly; human approval only suggested (pp.3,7)
llm_model: GPT-4o; Llama-3-70B/8B; Qwen2-72B/7B; Mixtral-8x7B; Mistral-7B (pre-trained and SFT)
key_result: Pre-trained GPT-4o matched 81/100 reference commands (SOP 100%, unexpected 41%); open models 29-75%; SFT in-sample up to 100% (p.6)
limitation: Accuracy below 100% is not fully reliable for direct control; suggest human-approved assistant use (p.7)
domain: modular production system (physical rig, offline dataset)
